description: The Databricks vector store builds its DELETE and UPDATE statements by interpolating the vector id, payload keys and payload values into the SQL text.

provenance.construction: reverse of a2ffca3266: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 8 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: Strings an attacker can influence (the memory id, payload keys used as column names, and payload values) are formatted into SQL with f-strings, with no bound parameters and no identifier validation, so a crafted value can change the statement. GitHub rated the advisory critical.

issues.description: The DELETE statement interpolates vector_id into the SQL string instead of binding a parameter.
The UPDATE SET clause interpolates both the payload key, used as a column name, and its value.
The UPDATE WHERE clause interpolates vector_id into the SQL string.
